thread:
dana-cs: FYI Lighthouse reported rising monthly inference spend and occasional entity normalization errors in finance chat. renewal in ~5w. health trending amber. i'm thinking a two-pronged performance play: intent routing + compact model hop for high-volume faq flows, plus opt-in int4 trial for internal beta. opinions?
marta-ml: good call. their telemetry shows ~65% Q/A short queries, ~18% multi-paragraph summaries, rest misc. cost and p95 tail are dominated by the short Q/A volume. compact + quantize could cut cost with minimal impact if we gate on entity-preservation metrics.
theo-se: can do intent routing. suggest: route intent:faq -> redwood/compact-mixture-v2 (int8), route intent:summary -> redwood/ppx-4.1 (fp). optional int4 trial on low-risk customer-only flag. Canary phases: 2% -> 15% -> 50% -> 100% with automated metric gates.
dana-cs: customer feedback snippet: "faster answers but sometimes ticker symbols lose $ prefix". they want objective tests before we escalate. add that to the renewal playbook.
marta-ml: propose evaluation suite: 800 anonymized examples focusing on entity types (tickers, CIKs, account numbers). metrics: entity_F1, answer_recall, latency_p95, cost_per_1k_tokens. Gate: entity_F1 >= prod - 1.0% and no customer-visible formatting regressions on sampled UX checks.
theo-se: routing rule draft (pseudo):
```yaml
routes:
  - match: "intent:faq"
    model: "redwood/compact-mixture-v2-int8"
    weight: 0.02
    overrides:
      - customer: "lighthouse"
        weight: 0.05
  - match: "intent:summary"
    model: "redwood/ppx-4.1"
    weight: 0.98
rollout:
  phases: ["10m","4h","24h","72h"]
  metrics_gate: "entity_F1 >= prod - 0.01 AND latency_p95_improve >= 0.15"
fallback:
  on_metric_drop: "switch_to_fp_for_customer(lighthouse)"
```
dana-cs: nice. what's the expected cost delta if we move Lighthouse faq traffic to compact-int8?
marta-ml: ballpark: 30-38% token cost reduction for faq flows, overall monthly spend down ~14% given their mix. latency p95 on faq path expected ~25-40% lower. int4 could add another ~10-12% savings but higher risk; recommend int8 first.
dana-cs: customer wants a rollback SLA: auto-rollback to full-precision if entity_F1 drops >1.5% in rolling 60m or if UX-sampled formatting fails 3 consecutive checks.
theo-se: implementable. we'll add a per-customer guard and a soft-override toggle for Lighthouse in the console. also enable prefix KV caching for repeated faq prefixes: cache.prefix_ttl=240s.
ops-bot: ticket created: CS-2011 "Lighthouse compact-routing pilot" assigned to @marta-ml,@theo-se,@dana-cs due 2026-03-08. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-2011 :white_check_mark:
marta-ml: i'll prepare the eval harness and run baseline vs compact-int8 and an int4 internal-only candidate. sample command: `./eval_tool --model redwood/compact-mixture-v2-int8 --dataset lighthouse_entities.json --metrics entity_F1,latency_p95,cost`
dana-cs: i'll sync with Lighthouse on eval-set sign-off and the renewal messaging (highlighting measurable cost savings + safety gates). update thread after the first run. :thumbsup:
